items.name: utils
items.title: utils
items.description: cn(): joins class names and resolves Tailwind conflicts. Shipped by Aedis so its dependencies are explicit.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The Aedis UI default theme: light, dark and the extra brand theme as CSS variables, Tailwind tokens, accessibility fallbacks and motion utilities. Import it once in your global CSS after tailwindcss.

items.name: custom-theme
items.title: Custom theme
items.description: Typed, validated custom themes: schema, contrast AA gate, applyTheme through the CSSOM and themeToCss for a nonce style. A theme is data, never CSS.

items.name: locale
items.title: Locale
items.description: Locale provider and English dictionary that every Aedis UI component reads its text from.

items.name: untrusted
items.title: untrusted
items.description: stripInvisible() removes code points that hide text from people but not from agents; safeUrl() keeps only http, https, mailto and relative URLs; isExternal().

items.name: api
items.title: api
items.description: api(): same-origin JSON client with CSRF header, refused redirects, timeout and typed errors for 401/403.

items.name: security-headers
items.title: securityHeaders
items.description: securityHeaders(): strict CSP with nonce, HSTS, no sniffing, no framing, no referrer leak; apply from middleware.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with variants and sizes; renders another element with the render prop.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label for form controls.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Container with header, content and footer.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status label.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visual or semantic divider.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder, hidden from assistive technology.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Responsive table parts.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed sections.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Confirmation for irreversible or outbound actions; focus starts on Cancel.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off toggle.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Single choice among options.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image with fallback initials.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short hint on hover or focus.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Grouped navigation with pending counters, disabled areas with a reason, and header/footer slots.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Sidebar + main layout that collapses behind a menu toggle on small screens.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Renders untrusted markdown: no raw HTML, safe link protocols, images off by default.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Conversation with an agent: safe rendering, working indicator, composer with limits.

items.name: use-event-stream
items.title: useEventStream
items.description: React hook over event-stream: subscribes to a same-origin SSE endpoint, resumes and reconnects, aborts on unmount.

items.name: use-idle-timeout
items.title: useIdleTimeout
items.description: Calls back after a period without pointer or keyboard activity, so the app can end the session.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: Agent request waiting for a human: approve through a confirmation, or request changes with a reason.

items.name: hand-raise
items.title: Hand Raise
items.description: Question an agent could not resolve alone, answered for this case or as a lasting rule.

items.name: locale-pt-br
items.title: Locale: Português (Brasil)
items.description: Brazilian Portuguese dictionary for Aedis UI components.

items.name: locale-es
items.title: Locale: Español
items.description: Spanish dictionary for Aedis UI components.

items.name: use-format
items.title: useFormat
items.description: Date, number, currency and relative time in the provider locale, on the platform Intl APIs.

items.name: locale-switcher
items.title: Locale Switcher
items.description: Accessible language picker that reports the choice to the app.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: True when the person asked for less motion, for motion driven by JavaScript.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code with token highlighting, copy and an animated line reveal. Hidden bidi and zero-width characters are shown, never run unseen.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Anchor for untrusted or configured URLs: safe protocols only, noopener noreferrer and a visible marker on external links.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels of grouped links, safe hrefs, external markers and an indicator that follows the open or current item.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Panel from an edge of the screen on Base UI Drawer: modal, swipe to dismiss with velocity, parallax content and an optional receding page.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu of actions on Base UI Menu: destructive items confirm through an AlertDialog that starts on Cancel, link items use safe URLs, items arrive in a cascade.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expanding sections on Base UI Accordion: height from the measured panel variable on the spring, findable with in-page search.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Show and hide one area on Base UI Collapsible, findable with in-page search.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callout for status, success, warnings and errors; role="alert" only for errors.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty state with a title, a description and what to do next.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator announced politely; static with a visible label under reduced motion.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or a key combination.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Labelled breadcrumb trail with safe links and the current page marked.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous, next and page links with safe hrefs; parsePage and paginationRange read untrusted page numbers as bounded integers.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: List row with media, content and actions; optional safe link that keeps its role inside a list.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scrollable region on Base UI ScrollArea: native scrolling and keyboard focus, scrollbars that fade in (still under reduced motion).

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Named group of buttons for toolbars and segmented actions; each button keeps its own semantics.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Feedback toasts on Base UI Toast: text only, errors announced urgently, generic failure message, pause on hover and focus, swipe to dismiss.

items.name: event-stream
items.title: event-stream
items.description: Secure SSE over fetch: same-origin, no token in the query, bounded parser with an event allow-list, Last-Event-ID resume, retry and backoff, stripInvisible on assembled events.

items.name: bff-stream
items.title: bffStream
items.description: Next.js route handler that relays an SSE stream with the server session's bearer: nothing from the browser goes upstream but a validated Last-Event-ID, generic errors, abort on disconnect.
